items.description: Acquired Mandi Board daily arrival panel of 3,892 records contains zero wheat and zero paddy records.
items.resolution_or_handling: Expose produce market arrivals only; do not attempt grain arrival anomaly calculations.

items.description: 3 records have modal_price == 0.0 as explicit clerk sentinel indicating price not reported.
items.resolution_or_handling: Treated as unobserved/not-reported; excluded from price averages.

items.description: All 53 paddy price records have null arrival quantities (100% missing).
items.resolution_or_handling: Preserve nulls; never default arrival quantity to 0.0 or combine with price series.

items.description: All 100 stock observation records have null state; coverage is India Central Pool only.
items.resolution_or_handling: Strictly label as National Central Pool; prohibit labeling as Punjab regional stock.

items.description: Procurement snapshot contains 3 rows with 3 different temporal bases and units for the same date.
items.resolution_or_handling: Marked cannot_be_summed=true; displayed as distinct analytical measures.

items.description: 6 rows have null area, production, and yield values (Fazilka, Pathankot, SAS Nagar in early years).
items.resolution_or_handling: Preserve null values in API output; do not replace with 0.

items.description: Malerkotla carved out of Sangrur in 2021/2022; historical APY series cannot be split retroactively.
items.resolution_or_handling: Maintain separate candidate mapping notes in crosswalk.
